question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute for the given group of words. **

A person holding conversational belief especially in matter of religion
solution:
The correct answer is "Orthodox."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• As a noun,** "orthodox"** typically refers to a person who adheres to established, traditional beliefs or doctrines, especially in religious contexts.
 
• For example, someone who follows traditional and established practices within a religious faith might be referred to as "orthodox**."**
 
• Therefore, a person holding conversational belief especially in matter of religion is called **"Orthodox."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Arsonist: **a person who intentionally starts a fire in order to damage or destroy something, especially a building. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज़, विशेषकर किसी इमारत को नुकसान पहुँचाने या नष्ट करने के लिए जानबूझकर आग लगाता है)
 
• **Compere: **a person who entertains the audience and introduces the different performers in a show. (किसी कार्यक्रम का प्रस्‍तुतकर्ता; सूत्रधार)
 
• **Prudent: **sensible and careful when making judgements and decisions; avoiding unnecessary risks. (मूल्‍यांकन और निर्णय करने में सावधान और विवेकपूर्ण; अनावश्‍यक ख़तरों से बचते हुए)
